platforms.name: Fiverr
platforms.tagline: Sell your skills as fixed-price gigs
platforms.whatItIs: A marketplace where you list services as gigs and buyers purchase them.
platforms.payRange: $5 - $500+ per gig, depending on skill and gig tier

platforms.name: Upwork
platforms.tagline: Find hourly and fixed-price freelance contracts
platforms.whatItIs: A freelance marketplace where you send proposals to clients and work on hourly or fixed-price contracts.
platforms.payRange: $5 - $100+ per hour, depending on skill and experience
platforms.minWithdrawal: $1 (PayPal, M-Pesa); higher for some bank options

platforms.name: Freelancer
platforms.tagline: Bid on projects posted by clients worldwide
platforms.whatItIs: A marketplace where clients post projects and freelancers bid to win them.

platforms.name: PeoplePerHour
platforms.tagline: UK-based marketplace for hourly work and fixed offers
platforms.whatItIs: A freelance marketplace where you send proposals or post fixed-price offers called Hourlies.
platforms.payRange: $10 - $50 per hour for most new freelancers

platforms.name: Swagbucks
platforms.tagline: Earn points for surveys, videos and shopping
platforms.whatItIs: A rewards site that pays points (SB) for surveys and other small online activities.
platforms.minWithdrawal: $25 for PayPal; gift cards from about $3

platforms.name: Toluna
platforms.tagline: Share opinions in surveys and product tests
platforms.whatItIs: A market research community that rewards members with points for surveys and polls.

platforms.name: YouGov
platforms.tagline: Opinion polls from a global research company
platforms.whatItIs: A market research and polling company that pays points for completing surveys.
tasks: Share views on brands and news topics

platforms.name: Attapoll
platforms.tagline: Quick mobile surveys on your phone
platforms.whatItIs: A mobile app that pays small rewards for short surveys.
tasks: Complete short surveys in the app

platforms.name: Clickworker
platforms.tagline: Small online tasks paid per task
platforms.whatItIs: A crowdsourcing platform where companies post micro jobs such as data labeling and text creation.

platforms.name: Appen
platforms.tagline: Project-based data and search quality work
platforms.whatItIs: A data company that hires remote contractors for search evaluation, data labeling and language projects.
platforms.minWithdrawal: No fixed minimum; paid per approved project

platforms.name: Remotasks
platforms.tagline: Training tasks for AI data labeling
platforms.whatItIs: A task platform where contributors label images, text and other data used to train AI systems.
platforms.payRange: $1 - $10 per hour, depending on task level

platforms.name: Rev
platforms.tagline: Transcribe audio and get paid weekly
platforms.whatItIs: A transcription company where freelancers type up audio and video files after passing a skills test.

platforms.name: GoTranscript
platforms.tagline: Flexible transcription jobs for freelancers
platforms.whatItIs: A transcription agency that hires freelancers to transcribe and review audio in many languages.

platforms.name: TranscribeMe
platforms.tagline: Short audio clips, paid weekly
platforms.whatItIs: A transcription service that splits audio into small clips for freelancers to transcribe.

platforms.name: Textbroker
platforms.tagline: Write articles for clients, paid per word
platforms.whatItIs: A content marketplace where writers are rated by level and paid per word for client orders.
tasks: Write blog posts and product descriptions
platforms.payRange: $0.007 - $0.05 per word, depending on your star level

platforms.name: iWriter
platforms.tagline: Article writing for beginners
platforms.whatItIs: A content writing marketplace where writers pick article requests and get paid per approved article.
tasks: Pick up requests from the writer queue

platforms.name: We Work Remotely
platforms.tagline: Large job board for remote positions
platforms.whatItIs: A job board that lists full-time and contract remote roles posted by companies.
tasks: Filter by role such as programming, design or support
platforms.payRange: Set by each employer, often $1,000 - $8,000+ per month
platforms.minWithdrawal: Not applicable; employers pay you directly

platforms.name: Remote.co
platforms.tagline: Curated remote jobs and company profiles
platforms.whatItIs: A remote work site with curated job listings and guides for working from home.
platforms.payRange: Set by each employer, often $1,000 - $8,000+ per month
platforms.minWithdrawal: Not applicable; employers pay you directly

platforms.name: Outlier
platforms.tagline: Expert tasks that train AI models
platforms.whatItIs: A platform where contractors write, review and rank content used to train AI models.
tasks: Check answers in your subject area
platforms.payRange: $15 - $50 per hour, depending on the project and your expertise

platforms.name: Scale AI
platforms.tagline: AI data company that hires contractors
platforms.whatItIs: A company that supplies labeled data for AI and hires contractors for annotation and review work.
platforms.minWithdrawal: Set per project and payment partner

platforms.name: DataAnnotation
platforms.tagline: Pay-per-task AI training work
platforms.whatItIs: A platform that pays contractors to evaluate and write content for AI training after a skills assessment.
platforms.minWithdrawal: No fixed minimum; paid per task period
